data.title: 星灯舞台前的花束与礼盒

data.animaCaption: Standing beneath glowing star decorations in her full Himematsu uniform, she cradles a sleek black gift box and a bouquet of pink and white flowers while smiling shyly down toward you. Warm stage bulbs rim her flowing silver hair and blazer shoulders.
data.promptProse: Framed in a clean vertical full-body shot from a slight low angle, Ayachi Nene stands before an illuminated festival stage draped with glowing star ornaments and warm fairy bulbs. Dressed in her crisp navy Himematsu blazer with gold buttons, yellow bowtie, grey plaid pleated skirt, black thighhighs, and polished loafers, she cradles a matte-black gift box beside a lush bouquet of pink and white blooms against her waist, offering a radiant shy smile as golden stage light rims her wind-lifted silver hair.
data.story: 学园祭晚会的星形灯饰在身后一盏盏亮起。宁宁怀里抱着刚收到的粉白花束和黑色礼盒，在温暖的舞台灯光下朝你微微侧身笑起来，眼里的光芒比身后整片灯海还要清澈。
